data.headline: Switch to Taiwan supplier at -10% cost and boost marketing 15%
data.why: The new supplier cuts unit cost by 10% while keeping the 4-week lead time, and the model shows this plan beats the steady-rival case by the figures above. Marketing lift of 15% adds volume that more than covers its spend, so profit rises without a price cut.
data.watch_out: If the new Taiwan source faces a logistics shock, cost exposure drops to 30% but a disruption could still delay replenishment for four weeks, leaving shelves empty during a demand spike.
data.recheck_when: Review when Vietnam semiconductor logistics news signals new port delays or when the rival changes price.
